text: Natalie Fairweather runs pre-launch UAT with real accounts from three actual Brindlewood partner companies.
Driscoll, Castle Rock Tooling, and Vantage Precision Group each submit a real test claim and check their own list.
Holly Vance, Driscoll's IT contact, tests her own integration against the live Scripted REST API too.
Every partner confirms the portal experience works exactly as intended -- clean sign-off, no trouble found.
Next: a dedicated security review that tests the same API in a way UAT never did.
